market.method: report value $262M (2024); est. bottom-up ~10k online units/yr x ~$20k + reagent sets ~$180 each = similar order. A $10.8B report figure was discarded as not credible

value.logic: Online PO4 control saved one WWTP $25-40k/yr ferric. Est. 20k P-limited plants worldwide without online control x ~$20k/yr chemical saved = $400M; plus ~$100M/yr less analyzer capex/reagents on the existing fleet (est.)
value.revenue_logic: est. 25k sensing caps/yr (new probes + 6-12 month refills) x $400 K14 share via OEM supply/license
value.margin_logic: sensor membrane consumable; binder is mg per cap

trend.drivers: tighter P limits (US to 0.05 mg/L, EU UWWTD recast); real-time nutrient control; watershed monitoring
trend.deadline: 2039: EU UWWTD tertiary (P) treatment at plants >=150k PE

competition.notes: No commercial reagent-free phosphate ISE found; work is academic (UWM graphene sensor patent, Clemson/ASU/NCSU impedimetric).

lab.synth: 1-2 step: bis-thiourea from catalog isothiocyanate + diamine, 3 variants
lab.test: PVC-membrane ISE; IUPAC selectivity (separate solution / fixed interference) vs Cl-, NO3-, SO4, HCO3; then real effluent vs EPA 365.1; university electrochemistry lab
lab.logic: synth 4 wk + membrane/electrode work 8 wk; 3 x $4k synth + ~$20k electrode testing + ~$3k EPA 365.1 reference samples

sale.gates: 6-12 month drift/lifetime field trial with OEM; process-control use needs no EPA approval (compliance needs 40 CFR 136 methods)
